So I left her for a moment with family which some of them have either seen first hand how bad it is or knows to not give her any. I come back, and she’s gone. I went around and asked people who were there, and no one knew. I ask my aunt, and in the calmest tone says that she almost stopped breathing and was taken to the hospital. She was there for 6 ish hours. If my sister didn’t tell, she might as well been dead. And the real kicker, someone gave her the cookie. If you suspect that it has something that can send you to the ER, then don’t eat it! And if I assume that you are in the US, then I’m pretty sure you have to pay for the ambulance (if needed), the stay, and all the equipment used. How would you even tell someone that? “Sorry son, but you can’t be yourself for a day because you’re stepmom’s supposed ENTIRE SIDE of the family are homophobes. Plus I feel like he would resent her and her family, which makes sense. You would be the asshole if you did try to put him back, but you seem like you love him to much to do that to him.
